title: Inexpensive Domain Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models: A Case Study on Biomedical Named Entity Recognition
answer_rationale: Text 1, Text 4, and Text 6 all explicitly state that the experiments were conducted on 'eight biomedical NER tasks'. Text 4 also specifies that these tasks are evaluated in comparison to BioBERT, and Text 6 confirms the evaluation covers 'eight out of eight biomedical NER tasks'.
